key_catalyst: President Trump declared the U.S.-Iran ceasefire 'over' and threatened fresh strikes, lifting oil prices (re-escalation of the Iran MACRO_SHOCK).
reasoning: The morning SELL thesis (semis SECTOR_ROTATION + Iran MACRO_SHOCK) failed to follow through intraday: no fresh chip-selloff headline hit the 9:30–15:45 window and QQQ rallied +0.92%, showing the market absorbed rather than extended the feared damage. The one genuinely new negative — Trump declaring the Iran ceasefire 'over' with strike threats and firmer oil — hit early and dinged only non-tech names (Kyndryl, DXC, Equifax) while the tech tape rallied through it, so it was not escalating into the close. What remains unresolved is residual Middle East re-escalation risk that could re-price in Asia/oil overnight.
